question: The Bandipur Tiger Reserve is in _______ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Bandipur Tiger Reserve** is located in the state of **Karnataka**, in southern India.
 
• It was established in **1974** as part of Project Tiger, a conservation program launched by the Government of India to protect tigers and their habitats.
 
• The reserve is part of the **Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve**, which encompasses parts of Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Kerala, making it one of the largest protected areas in India.
 
• The Bandipur Tiger Reserve covers an area of approximately **874 square kilometers** and is known for its rich biodiversity, including Bengal tigers, Indian elephants, leopards, and various other species.
 
• It is famous for its dry deciduous forests, tropical mixed deciduous forests, and grassy woodlands, offering a diverse habitat for wildlife.
